title: 再生缘 · 刻本
source: 清代弹词刻本 · 再生缘刻本（全书 204 页 PDF）
sourceEn: Qing-era tanci print: Zai Sheng Yuan (woodblock) — full 204-page PDF

reading.zh: 《再生缘》是清代弹词名作。孟丽君女扮男装考取功名，智勇双全，终与皇甫少华历经波折而团圆。
reading.zhHant: 《再生緣》是清代彈詞名作。孟麗君女扮男裝考取功名，智勇雙全，終與皇甫少華歷經波折而團圓。
reading.en: Zai Sheng Yuan is a celebrated Qing tanci. Meng Lijun disguises herself as a man, wins official rank, and after many trials reunites with Huangfu Shaohua.
